title: [maintainer] smtp_peer_down_secs config default not explained
description: Config field smtp_peer_down_secs defaults to 300 seconds (5 minutes) (config.rs:224-249, relay_health.rs). But: TOML schema does NOT document what 'down' state means or when backoff is appropriate. Default suitable for intra-datacenter but wrong for geographically distributed or unreliable peers. Solo operator might set it too low (thrashing, rapid reconnects) or too high (long queue backlog during peer outage) without clear guidance. Need: add documentation to config.rs explaining down-backoff semantics and provide example tuning for different deployment scenarios (local relay, cloud peer, etc.).
